### Example directory structure for config discovery

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/config.mdx

For example, start OpenCode from /home/user/projects/acme/packages/web.

```text
/etc/opencode/opencode.json
~/.config/opencode/opencode.json

/home/user/projects/acme/
├── opencode.json
└── packages/
    └── web/
        ├── opencode.json
        └── src/
```

--------------------------------

### Initial load and background plugin boot flow

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/specs/v2/catalog-config-plugin-lifecycle.md

Illustrates building a baseline catalog from immediate sources while background fibers activate slower plugins asynchronously.

```ts
LocationServiceMap.get(ref)
  → build location layer
    → Catalog.layer creates empty catalog state
    → PluginBoot.layer activates immediately available plugins
      → ConfigProviderPlugin installs Catalog.transform()
      → ModelsDevPlugin installs Catalog.transform()
      → AuthPlugin installs Catalog.transform()
    → Catalog.layer applies active transforms during boot
    → apply policy
    → materialize baseline provider/model catalog
  → PluginBoot baseline ready
    → Frontend.fetchCatalog()

PluginBoot background fiber
  → install/update plugin packages concurrently
  → activate completed plugins
    → Catalog.transform()
      → transform(updateCatalog)
        → Catalog internally rebuilds
          → Catalog.Event.Updated
            → Frontend.refetchCatalog()
```

--------------------------------

### Build and run desktop startup benchmarks

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/desktop/README.md

Builds the desktop application with electron-builder and executes startup benchmark commands under various configurations, such as warm/cold services, A/B comparisons, and profiling flags.

```bash
OPENCODE_CHANNEL=dev bun run build && bunx electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.config.ts
bun run bench:startup -- --runs 5                                  # warm service (started once, reused by every launch)
bun run bench:startup -- --runs 5 --compare dist/other/OpenCode\ Dev.exe   # A/B: alternate launches of two builds
bun run bench:startup -- --service cold                            # each launch spawns the service
bun run bench:startup -- --fresh                                   # first launch after an install (profile wiped each time)
bun run bench:startup -- --profile-main --profile-renderer --trace # CPU profiles and a Chromium startup trace
bun run bench:startup -- --seed "%APPDATA%\ai.opencode.desktop.dev"   # restore tabs and drafts from an existing profile
```

--------------------------------

### TextNode Range Methods

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/plugins/figma/skills/figma-use-figjam/references/edit-text.md

SDK methods on TextNode for getting and setting properties across a specific character range (start to end indices).

```APIDOC
## TextNode Range Methods

### Description
Methods available on `TextNode` instances to apply mixed styling, fonts, fills, hyperlinks, and list options to specific character ranges.

### Methods
- `textNode.setRangeFontName(start, end, fontName)`
- `textNode.setRangeFontSize(start, end, size)`
- `textNode.setRangeFills(start, end, fills)`
- `textNode.setRangeTextDecoration(start, end, decoration)`
- `textNode.setRangeTextCase(start, end, textCase)`
- `textNode.setRangeLetterSpacing(start, end, spacing)`
- `textNode.setRangeLineHeight(start, end, lineHeight)`
- `textNode.setRangeHyperlink(start, end, hyperlink)`
- `textNode.setRangeListOptions(start, end, listOptions)`
- `textNode.setRangeIndentation(start, end, indentation)`
- `textNode.getRangeFontName(start, end)`
- `textNode.getRangeFontSize(start, end)`

### Usage Examples
```javascript
// Make "Hello" bold (characters 0-5)
textNode.setRangeFontName(0, 5, { family: 'Inter', style: 'Bold' });

// Make "World" red (characters 6-11)
textNode.setRangeFills(6, 11, [{ type: 'SOLID', color: { r: 1, g: 0, b: 0 } }]);

// Change size of "World"
textNode.setRangeFontSize(6, 11, 24);

// Get properties for a range
const fontAtStart = textNode.getRangeFontName(0, 1);
const sizeAtEnd = textNode.getRangeFontSize(10, 11);
```
```

### Configure Virtual Framebuffer for Headless Environments

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/bs/troubleshooting.mdx

Installs and initializes Xvfb and sets the DISPLAY environment variable to support clipboard functionality in headless Linux setups.

```bash
apt install -y xvfb
# and run:
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 > /dev/null 2>&1 &
export DISPLAY=:99.0
```

--------------------------------

### List and get agents using Effect

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/build/plugins/effect.mdx

Use this to read all agents or fetch a specific agent by ID. The example logs the count of agents and the name of the 'build' agent.

```typescript
effect: (ctx) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const agent = ctx.agent
    const agents = yield* agent.list().pipe(Effect.orDie)
    const build = yield* agent.get({ agentID: Agent.ID.make("build") }).pipe(Effect.orDie)
    yield* Effect.logInfo("agents", { count: agents.data.length, build: build.data.name })
  }),
```

### Start OpenCode CLI Session

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/cli/tui.mdx

Navigate to the target project directory and launch OpenCode.

```bash
cd ~/code/my-project
opencode
```

--------------------------------

### Wildcard pattern matching on resource in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/policies.mdx

Applies a wildcard pattern using * to match zero or more characters in the resource ID. This example denies any provider starting with company-.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "experimental": {
    "policies": [
      {
        "effect": "deny",
        "action": "provider.use",
        "resource": "company-*"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Initialize client with createOpencode

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/sdk.mdx

Create an instance of opencode to start both a server and a client.

```javascript
import { createOpencode } from "@opencode-ai/sdk"

const { client } = await createOpencode()
```

--------------------------------

### List and get providers using Effect

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/build/plugins/effect.mdx

Use this to read all available providers or fetch a specific provider by ID. The example logs the count of providers and the name of the 'anthropic' provider.

```typescript
effect: (ctx) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const provider = ctx.provider
    const providers = yield* provider.list().pipe(Effect.orDie)
    const anthropic = yield* provider.get({ providerID: Provider.ID.make("anthropic") }).pipe(Effect.orDie)
    yield* Effect.logInfo("providers", {
      providers: providers.data.length,
      anthropic: anthropic.data.name,
    })
  }),
```

--------------------------------

### List available models and default selection

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/build/plugins/effect.mdx

Use ctx.model.list() to retrieve all available models and ctx.model.default() to get the currently selected model. The example logs the count and selected model name.

```typescript
effect: (ctx) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const model = ctx.model
    const models = yield* model.list().pipe(Effect.orDie)
    const selected = yield* model.default().pipe(Effect.orDie)
    yield* Effect.logInfo("models", { count: models.data.length, selected: selected.data?.name })
  }),
```

### Launch Vite TUI live development session with bun

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/cli/dev/README.md

Starts the CLI and its TUI via Vite and solid-refresh from the repository root, connecting directly to the installed server. Component edits trigger hot updates while the backend remains active across syntax error retries and full reloads.

```sh
bun run dev:vite:live /path/to/project
```

### Install OpenCode using the shell script

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/index.mdx

```bash
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Create an OpenCode client and start a session

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/build/client/index.mdx

Instantiate an OpenCode client with OpenCode.make and invoke resource methods like session.create and session.prompt.

```ts
import { OpenCode } from "@opencode/client"

const client = OpenCode.make({
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:4096",
})

const session = await client.session.create({
  location: { directory: "/workspace" },
})

await client.session.prompt({
  sessionID: session.id,
  text: "Review the current changes",
})
```

### Install OpenCode CLI with curl

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/index.mdx

Install the OpenCode CLI using the curl installer script.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenCode CLI

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.md

Install the OpenCode CLI using the curl shell installer or various package managers across macOS, Linux, and Windows. Remove versions older than 0.1.x before installing.

```bash
# YOLO
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash

# Package managers
npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest      # or bun/pnpm/yarn
scoop install opencode             # Windows
choco install opencode             # Windows
brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode # macOS and Linux (recommended, always up to date)
brew install opencode              # macOS and Linux (official brew formula, updated less)
sudo pacman -S opencode            # Arch Linux (Stable)
paru -S opencode-bin               # Arch Linux (Latest from AUR)
mise use -g opencode               # Any OS
nix run nixpkgs#opencode           # or github:anomalyco/opencode for latest dev branch
```

--------------------------------

### Add a custom LSP server with command and extensions

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/lsp.mdx

Define a new LSP entry by specifying the startup `command` array and the file `extensions` the server should handle.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "lsp": {
    "custom-lsp": {
      "command": ["custom-lsp-server", "--stdio"],
      "extensions": [".custom"]
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenCode CLI to Custom Directory

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.md

Override the target installation directory using OPENCODE_INSTALL_DIR or XDG_BIN_DIR environment variables when executing the install script.

```bash
# Examples
OPENCODE_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
XDG_BIN_DIR=$HOME/.local/bin curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
```

### GET /path

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/server.mdx

Gets the current path information from the server.

```APIDOC
## GET /path

### Description
Get the current path

### Method
GET

### Endpoint
`/path`

### Response
#### Success Response (200)
- `Path`
```

--------------------------------

### Return a cleanup function from setup

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/services/www/src/docs/content/build/plugins/index.mdx

setup runs when the plugin loads; the returned function runs when the plugin unloads. ctx.app.version is available in the context.

```typescript
import { Plugin } from "@opencode/plugin"

export default Plugin.define({
  id: "example",
  setup(ctx) {
    console.log(`loaded in OpenCode ${ctx.app.version}`)
    return () => console.log("unloaded")
  },
})
```

### Start OpenCode server for desktop app connection

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/windows-wsl.mdx

Starts the server in WSL listening on 0.0.0.0 at port 4096 to allow external desktop app connections.

```bash
opencode serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096
```

### Configure and start opencode server instance

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/sdk.mdx

Pass custom configuration options such as hostname, port, and model settings inline to override defaults or opencode.json.

```javascript
import { createOpencode } from "@opencode-ai/sdk"

const opencode = await createOpencode({
  hostname: "127.0.0.1",
  port: 4096,
  config: {
    model: "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
  },
})

console.log(`Server running at ${opencode.server.url}`)

opencode.server.close()
```

### Declare main process store imported from settings using Store.main

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/gui-extensions/README.md

Creates a main process store that loads synchronously and imports initial state from a desktop settings key.

```ts
// The saved hosts, which main keeps; stored before in the desktop settings file.
servers: Store.main(Schema.Array(SshConfig), [], { settings: "ssh.servers" }),
```

### Define extension setup function

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/gui-extensions/README.md

Implements synchronous extension setup using typed context to access dependencies, loaded stores, translations, and contribute commands to the registry.

```ts
const setup: Setup<typeof definition> = (ctx) => {
  const changes = ctx.uses.changes // Accessor<Live<Changes>>
  const prefs = ctx.stores.prefs.value // loaded before setup
  ctx.add(Command, { id: "open", title: ctx.t("open"), run: () => ctx.layout.settings(ctx.id) })
}
```
